name: (Z)-β-Ocimene

pubchem.title: beta-Ocimene, (3Z)-
pubchem.description: (Z)-beta-ocimene is a beta-ocimene that consists of octa-1,3,6-triene bearing two methyl substituents at positions 3 and 7 (the 3Z-isomer). It has a role as a plant metabolite.
